import numpy as np

def dynamics(t, x, u):
    pitch_rate = float(x[0])
    pitch_angle = float(x[1])
    depth = float(x[2])
    stern_plane_angle = float(u[0])

    pitch_inertia = 469.0
    added_pitch_inertia = -458.0
    stern_plane_moment = -1575.9
    pitch_damping = 9826.2
    pitch_stiffness = 13719.6
    forward_speed = 20.0
    effective_inertia = pitch_inertia - added_pitch_inertia

    pitch_rate_dot = -(pitch_damping*pitch_rate + pitch_stiffness*pitch_angle + stern_plane_moment*stern_plane_angle)/effective_inertia
    pitch_angle_dot = pitch_rate
    depth_dot = forward_speed*pitch_angle
    return np.array([pitch_rate_dot, pitch_angle_dot, depth_dot], dtype=float)

state_meanings: Vehicle pitch rate in radians per second.
Vehicle depth in metres, positive downward.
assumptions: SISO system with one declared control input and one controlled output.
